correctness.rationale: The count is reduced, by the exact fixed-point formula of Fan, to finite integer congruence counts. The standalone checker verifies all 72 prime-field interpolation points by exhaustive modular Burnside enumeration, and independently checks 12 extra prime-field values and three complete small orbit sets. Fan Theorem 4.5 supplies the rigorous degree-five/quasi-period-twelve statement; equality at six primes in each residue proves the infinite formula by polynomial identity. Distinct residues yield incompatible coefficients and, by CRT plus Dirichlet primes, establish least period twelve even on the prime-power domain. The general theorem is an explicitly cited premise.

value.rationale: The first squarefree composite index is a natural structurally different test case for the newly developed general orbit classification. The result gives the complete six-phase closed formula and shows that the universal 2ell even-index period bound is genuinely sharp here, whereas the previously evaluated index-four case has a smaller period. The exact period is a motivated arithmetic invariant, not an arbitrary small finite statistic; the complete formulas apply to infinitely many finite fields.
